name: Sugarcane juice
summary: Nước mía is sweet sugarcane juice sold in Chợ Châu Đốc just after sunrise, between the flower stalls, the steaming noodle bowls, and the stacks of mắm. Drink it cold while the hall fills up.
origin: Chợ Châu Đốc in the early morning.
howToEat: Drink it cold at the market, from just after sunrise. By 7:00 the hall is busy.
where: Chợ Châu Đốc, in the morning.
seoDescription: Nước mía is the cold sugarcane juice of Chợ Châu Đốc in the early morning, beside the noodle bowls and the mắm.
